item.description: MADISON – Madison Mayor Ranae Bartlett described a visit to Montgomery and Madison Elementary School in her “Madison Weekly” newsletter.

item.title: Mustangs to retire jersey of longtime coach Mike Good - news
item.description: MADISON - Madison Academy will officially retire the iconic No. 22 jersey of longtime former baseball coach Mike Good during a special on-field ceremony on Friday, April 3 at 5:15 p.m. prior to the Mustangs game against Guntersville.

item.title: MPD: Three charged in murder conspiracy - news
item.description: MADISON — Authorities say a convicted murderer already serving a life sentence may soon face additional charges after investigators uncovered an alleged murder-for-hire scheme tied to a Dec. shooting in Madison.

item.title: Journey theatre students realize Greek/ Roman’s influence on Western Theatre - news
item.description: MADISON – Students enrolled in beginning theatre at Journey Middle School envisioned ancient stages of Europe to learn about the origins of Western Theatre.

item.title: Bob Jones Theatre is ‘in the money’ with ‘42nd Street” - news
item.description: MADISON – Do you want to be ‘in the money’ listening to a ‘lullaby of Broadway’? Just head down to “42nd Street” with Bob Jones Theatre’s spring musical.

item.title: American Academy In Rome accepts Terrena Mann for Classical Summer School - news
item.description: MADISON – Terrena Mann has been accepted into Classical Summer School with the American Academy In Rome. Mann was fortunate to receive a full scholarship that will help her to further her education on Greek/Roman theatre.

item.title: Madison to gain a new designated nature preserve - news
item.description: MADISON – The Land Trust of North Alabama has announced a new sanctuary in Madison with Mill Creek Nature Preserve in the city’s northern section.

item.title: Madison Public Library, Madison Visionary Partners plan Community Volunteer Fair to match people, needs - news
item.description: MADISON – Madison Visionary Partners or MVP and Huntsville- Madison County Public Library will host a Community Volunteer Fair in April.
